_comment: Inputs and choices for the offline style bundle. generate_style.mjs and fetch_style_inputs.py read this file.
_glyph_ranges_note: Real glyphs are shipped for these ranges only (Basic Latin, Latin-1 Supplement incl. e-acute, Latin Extended-A, Combining Diacritical Marks + Greek, General Punctuation such as curly quotes and dashes). Every other range of the Basic Multilingual Plane gets a tiny valid-but-empty PBF so that a rare name in another script renders without those characters instead of failing the whole tile. See docs/experiments/02-map.md for the coverage measured on the PA names.

label_overrides._note: Paint overrides on top of the Protomaps flavors, so that street, address and place names are readable while driving. generate_style.mjs checks the WCAG contrast ratio of text-color against text-halo-color (the colour directly around the letters) and stops if it is below min_contrast (or the layer's own _min_contrast). Night street labels (roads_labels_major, roads_labels_minor) must reach 7:1, the level the map engineer measured; the generator stops otherwise.

stock_pois._note: Text colours of the stock pois layer (a case expression by kind group), old -> new, chosen by lowering (day) or raising (night) only the OKLCH lightness until the colour reaches 4.6:1 against the POI halo. generate_style.mjs replaces them and checks every colour the expression can produce against min_contrast.

driving_tweaks._oneway_reverse_note: roads whose oneway value means 'against the drawing direction' get a second arrow layer rotated by 180 degrees. 'alternating' and 'reversible' have no fixed direction and get no arrow.
driving_tweaks._driving_pois_note: The driving POI layer (pois_driving) takes its kinds, icons and the kinds shown early from assets/poi_icons.json. early_kinds are shown early_kinds_zoom_advance zoom levels before their min_zoom attribute. Measured (count_pois.py): rest areas and service plazas from z12-13 on the highway, parking from z13-14 in town, fuel and charging from z15 (named fuel stations are only in the z15 tiles of a z0-15 pack, so z15 is the earliest for them without a tile-profile change).

stock_poi_min_zoom._note: Shops and cafes of the stock pois layer are not shown before this zoom, whatever their min_zoom, so that fuel and charging (z15) come before them. Without it supermarkets appeared at z14.

shield_style._note: Route shields: icon-size 1 and text-size 10 (stock: 0.8 and 8, the same ratio, 25 % larger for reading while driving). Shield art and network rules: assets/shields/shields.json.

overview_legibility._note: Round 3 (track P): below below_zoom only the overview map is drawn (z0-7 tiles; state packs start at z8), and the stock flavors draw interstates there as a hairline in the road colour (white on the light earth by day: contrast 1.3:1) without casing, and state lines 0.4 px wide, so neither could be seen at z3-5. Below below_zoom, roads_highway gets the colour and widths here and the boundaries layer (state lines and smaller) the colour and width here; from below_zoom up the stock paint is unchanged. generate_style.mjs checks each colour against the flavor's earth colour (min_contrast, the WCAG 1.4.11 non-text minimum).
